title: Vanex Defense
tagline: Build the maze. Hold the line.
shortDescription: Command an elemental defense grid. Build and maze towers, counter each wave’s elements, specialize, field a hero and hold the line across six worlds, or build your own map.
longDescription: Vanex Defense is an elemental tower-defense strategy game. As Commander of the Vanex Defense Grid you face the Shardbound, crystal constructs breaking through a rift. Build towers and make a maze, read each wave’s intel, counter its elements with combo towers and specializations, field a commander hero and call down abilities, while PIP, the grid’s tactical AI, keeps you briefed. There are six worlds and 18 hand-made sectors, plus a Daily challenge, Endless mode and a Map Workshop for building and sharing your own sectors.
features: 6 worlds and 18 hand-made sectors with gates, drawbridges, sky lanes and shifting ground
23 towers, including 15 combo towers, and 42 specializations
17 crystal constructs and 4 multi-phase bosses with telegraphed attacks
4 commander heroes, 3 abilities and a research lab
Story, Normal, Hard and Expert, challenge medals, a Daily challenge and Endless mode
Map Workshop: build your own sector, test it with bots and share it as a code
English and Filipino, colour-blind-friendly elements and remappable keys
contentNotes: Sci-fi battles against crystal robots: towers fire energy beams and constructs shatter into crystal shards. No blood, gore or scary horror. Campaign progress and settings save in this browser.

quickStart: Tap or click a tower card, then an open square, to build.
Make a maze so the constructs walk past your towers.
Read the wave intel, then start the next wave.
howToPlay: Tap or click a tower card, then a square and the checkmark to build. Keys 1–0 pick towers.
Select a tower to upgrade, sell or change targeting (U, S and T). At level 3, pick one of two specializations.
Move your commander with the hero button or H, use its special with Q, and use abilities with Z, X and C.
Drag and pinch, or drag and use the mouse wheel, to move and zoom the map. Press and hold anything to learn about it.
Start or call the next wave with N or Enter, change speed with F and pause with P or Space. Keys can be changed in Settings.

playTime: 15–25 minutes per sector; 8–12 hours for the campaign
